picks.speaker: Lock & Cash
picks.rationale: Jets return home facing a reeling Raiders team on a 4-game losing streak with a porous defense. The Jets' defensive line and pass rush should generate pressure on Kirk Cousins, who struggles playing from behind. Model line is Jets -3.
picks.quote: small spread just need him to win i really like the jets on the money line i project the jets by the way... my line is jets minus three on this game

picks.speaker: Lock & Cash
picks.rationale: Ravens getting the key +3.5 hook in Buffalo. Even if Lamar Jackson is limited or Tyler Huntley starts, Huntley has proven capable in road underdog spots (already won outright as road dog at this line this season) without crossing critical numbers.
picks.quote: the best bet for me easily in this game ravens plus three and a half... Love the Ravens plus three and a half.

picks.speaker: Lock & Cash
picks.rationale: Bears +3.5 on Monday Night Football is a live dog with strong upset potential. Seattle's offense remains inconsistent and cannot establish the run, giving Chicago two-way edges and the defensive ability to disrupt Darnold.
picks.quote: i really like chicago plus three and a half to keep that game at least within a field goal but i expect an outright win

picks.speaker: Sal Vetri
picks.rationale: With backup Ryan Robinson injured, Bijan saw over 80% snap share and 20+ opportunities in Week 7. Even though Tampa Bay has a stout run defense, Robinson's guaranteed elite volume should push him over 79.5 rushing yards.
picks.quote: You want to start by taking Bijan Robinson for more than 79.5 rushing yards... His backup, Ryan Robinson, is hurt... Bijan playing over 80% of the snaps, seeing 20-plus opportunities.

picks.speaker: Sal Vetri
picks.rationale: A.J. Brown leads New England with a 27% target share since returning early from his high ankle sprain. Drake Maye is playing at an MVP level, and Miami's secondary ranks #27 against the pass.
picks.quote: Next up, you want to take A.J. Brown for more than 59.5 receiving yards. This number is way too low... Drake Maye playing like an MVP... Expect a big bounce back against the number 27 Dolphins defense.

picks.speaker: Sal Vetri
picks.rationale: Brissett has thrown 35+ passes in 6 of 7 games this season (including 48 pass attempts in Week 7) and faces a vulnerable Dallas secondary that allows the fourth-most passing yards per play.
picks.quote: expect Jacoby Brissett to continue to pile on passing yards you want to take him for more than 249 and a half passing yards... gets to face the cowboys defense that allows the fourth most passing yards per play

picks.speaker: Sal Vetri
picks.rationale: Goff faces Minnesota's league-leading pass defense allowing just 155 pass yards per game. Brian Flores blitzes at an NFL-high 68% rate where Goff historically struggles, and Amon-Ra St. Brown is playing through an ankle injury.
picks.quote: now we're going to take an under here we're taking jared goff for less than 274 and a half passing yards... facing the vikings they have the best defense in the nfl they only allow 155 passing yards per game

pick.speaker: Sal Vetri
pick.rationale: Speaker introduces pick as 'more than 59.5 rushing yards' but his substantive analysis argues that Gordon will be inefficient and scripted out as a 7.5-point underdog against New England's top-10 run defense, before the clip cuts off at 'which is why...'.
pick.quote: and take our number one pick which is Ollie Gordon for more than 59 and a half rushing yards look... I think this is the game where he's probably not going to get there... which is why

dropped.reason: Contradictory pick side: verbally introduced as 'more than' (OVER) but entire rationale argues for UNDER ('probably not going to get there... inefficient... playing from behind... factored out in second half'), and clip abruptly cuts off mid-sentence.
